env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^present true 37$'
stdout '^absent false -1$'
stdout '^projected ada -1$'
stdout '^projected unset 41$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/optioncopy

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/optioncopy/owner"
)

type Row struct {
	Score int?
}

type OptionRow struct {
	Name  string?
	Count int64?
}

func main() {
	present := owner.CopyRow[Row](Row{Score: 37})
	absent := owner.CopyRow[Row](Row{})
	fmt.Println("present", present.Score != nil, present.Score ?? -1)
	fmt.Println("absent", absent.Score != nil, absent.Score ?? -1)

	named := OptionRow{Name: "ada"}
	counted := OptionRow{Count: 41}
	projectedName := projectOptions(&named)
	projectedCount := projectOptions(&counted)
	fmt.Println("projected", projectedName.Name ?? "unset", projectedName.Count ?? -1)
	fmt.Println("projected", projectedCount.Name ?? "unset", projectedCount.Count ?? -1)
}

-- m/projection.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/optioncopy/owner"

func projectOptions(row *OptionRow) OptionRow {
	return owner.ProjectRow[OptionRow](row)
}

-- m/owner/owner.lgo --
package owner

import "comptime"

func CopyRow[T any](row T) T {
	var out T
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out.[f] = CopyField[f.Type](row.[f])
	}
	return out
}

func CopyField[T any](field T) T {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		comptime.Error("CopyField requires a non-struct field")
	}
	return field
}

func ProjectRow[T any](row *(T)) T {
	var out T
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out.[f] = ReadField[f.Type](&row.[f])
	}
	return out
}

func ReadField[F any](field *(F)) F {
	return *field
}
